page.notes: Scan resolution is low and the lines are small. Words in this transcription are a best reading and some are uncertain: "viri" for "vir", "vlm" for "vtrum", "Heburnū", "Srerlini", "Maithaeus", "Lathamomnes", "comnocaris", "Siephanum" and "praefagirent" need checking, and the sentence beginning "Augebat" and the passage about Forbosius are the least reliable. The paragraph divisions are approximate: the first lines of paragraphs are not clearly indented on this scan. The line-number markers 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 stand in the text column and are kept where they appear. Some words of the final lines are not legible on the scan and should be checked against the original. The last line ends in "horta-", a word broken at the page's foot, which continues on the next page. No page number, catchword or signature is visible.
